system.description:
[Trigger: Action] Your "Turning Swallow" and "Multiple Darts" are used simultaneously. The attack range is increased by +1Sq. A throwing weapon imbued with the concept of death through the engraving of ill omens and ominous stars, and the performance of magical rituals. Though difficult to handle, it boasts high power and a long range.

Bloodstained Blade[Core Material](50G)+Four-Star Hand Dagger(60G)×2+[Magic Catalyst 4](30G)×2+Crafting Cost(90G)
